description: Part single/part two storey rear extension, two storey side extension, rear dormer and front and side roof lights.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice.Location Plan Dated 31.03.2026;Site Location Plan AJC-1602-01 Dated 09.01.2026;Existing Ground & First Floor Plans AJC-1602-02 Dated 09.01.2026;Existing Second Floor & Roof Plans AJC-1602-03 Dated 09.01.2026;Existing Elevations AJC-1602-06 Dated 09.01.2026;Existing & Proposed Sections AJC-1602-08 Dated 09.01.2026;Existing & Proposed Site Plans AJC-1602-09 Rev A Dated 09.Apr.2026;Proposed Ground & First Floor Plans AJC-1602-04 Dated 09.01.2026;Proposed Second Floor & Roof Plans AJC-1602-05 Dated 09.01.2026;	Proposed Elevations AJC-1602-07 Dated 09.01.2026;Design & Access Statement;		Planning Statement;		Sustainable Drainage Strategy;		SuDS Pro-forma.	Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external finishes shall be in materials to match those of the exterior of the existing buildings unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority in writing.  Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
The first floor side gable windows shall be fitted with obscure glazing and shall be retained as such for the duration of the development hereby permitted.Reason: To safeguard residential amenity.
